brief: How to build an email funnel that converts at 9%.

slots.title: Email funnels that convert
slots.ctaText: Learn the exact system right here

slots.title: Map Your Lead Magnet
slots.body: Start with a freebie your dream customer actually wants. Keep it specific, valuable, and easy to consume in under five minutes.

slots.title: Write a Welcome Sequence
slots.body: Your first three emails build trust fast. Share your story, set expectations, and tease the transformation you deliver.

slots.title: Segment Your Subscribers
slots.body: Tag people based on what they click and buy. Segmented emails drive way more revenue than one-size-fits-all blasts.

slots.title: Sell With Storytelling
slots.body: Nobody likes a hard pitch. Use relatable stories, social proof, and a clear deadline to nudge readers toward the buy button.

slots.title: Optimize Your Subject Lines
slots.body: Test curiosity-driven hooks against direct benefit lines. Even a small bump in open rates can double your funnel revenue.

slots.title: Test and Scale Up
slots.body: Watch your metrics weekly and kill what flops. Once you hit nine percent, pour more traffic into the winning flow.

slots.headline: Build Your Funnel Now
slots.body: Steal the exact template and hit 9% conversions this quarter.
